result:
I planned round 436: the first half of COPY-PD-VIS, the two open Medium copy fixes. Saba approved the wording; one unit question is still open with him (below). The decision is **CONTINUE**.

**Round 435 accepted.** C's RETRO round passed with 0 bugs and was verified in a real browser. The gate skipped publishing because no source changed, so the baseline stays `8233840`. C only partly re-checked the 11 tags behind the new source-scan helper task, so I checked all 11 myself; each is tagged. One cold dev-server error came back, and I recorded it on the existing Low C-R425-01 rather than as a new bug. The old task is copied to `tasks/round-435.md`; nothing was deleted.

**Round 436:**
- **"Source offset" becomes "Clip origin" (STUDIO-VIS-4, SR-435-2).** The word appeared in three places: the Detail panel, the footer clip line with its tooltip, and the move/trim status message in `ArrangementClip.tsx`. After the change it appears nowhere a user can see or hear it.
- **"From, s" / "To, s" become "From" / "To" (STUDIO-VIS-6).** The inputs' screen-reader names keep "(seconds)", so the unit is still announced.
- **The code change is ready-made:** 10 files, all of it plain string swaps. A applies it as given, and also writes implementation doc 283.

**Checks run on the change (before A builds it):**
- The 8 directly affected test files pass (208 tests), and the full test suite passes (272 files, 4018 tests). Typecheck is clean, and lint shows the same 205 warnings as `8233840`.
- Reverting any one of the five strings turns tests red, so the tests do catch a revert.
- In Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720, current `8233840` against the change:
  - every label and field box is the same size and position;
  - the always-visible text line counts are unchanged;
  - "source offset" goes from 11 occurrences to 0.
- tech-lead reviewed the change and approved it with two minor findings, both moved to the deferred list:
  - the status message keeps its text inline instead of in `strings.ts`;
  - the visible "From"/"To" isn't part of the inputs' screen-reader names. That was already the case before this change.

**Decision for Saba:** the fields now show bare seconds while Live 12 shows min:sec:ms (manual §8.2.1). This is his open question Q4; the task uses his approved "From"/"To" until he answers.

**Split (D-29z1545):** the three visual Lows go to round 437, because each needs per-state decisions and contrast measurements: the filled brass Export button (STUDIO-VIS-7), the "CZABA" back link colour (STUDIO-VIS-10), and Saba's thin lane-resize handle, which also needs its "Why we missed it" section and a lesson. The "filled primary button" item in COPY-PD is delivered by STUDIO-VIS-7. No root patch is pending on the export dialog, so there is no ownership clash.

**Order after 437:** the regression round when it falls due (on or after 2026-11-13), then the source-scan helper task, SYS-1, SYS-3, Store redesign stages 2b–5, ARCH-SPLIT, the review recommendations and T12-ADVANCED. STEM-LANES moves ahead as soon as Saba answers; he hasn't yet.

The advisor was available and I used it twice, after orientation and before closing. The second review found four task rows that claimed results I hadn't measured. I ran those checks on current `8233840` and on the change, and rewrote the rows from the saved outputs. The store tree is clean at `8233840`; only loop artifacts changed.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `current-task.md`
- `b-round-435.md`
- `b-next.json`
- `feature-status.md`
- `backlog.json` (v420, decisions D-29z1544–1547)
- `b-round-435/` (supporting artifacts)
